rules.action: Standard workhorse wire for crossing; exchange to extra-support wire before device delivery through heavily calcified segments.
rules.rationale: Extra-support wire improves deliverability of balloons and atherectomy systems through resistant calcium.
rules.detail: Exchange before stent delivery if resistance is felt on balloon advancement.

rules.action: Soft steerable workhorse wire; gentle primary curve only.
rules.rationale: Over-shaping the tip straightens the vessel and increases wall stress.
rules.detail: Avoid aggressive tip angulation — a gentle curve navigates tortuous segments more reliably and reduces risk of vessel trauma.

rules.action: Soft steerable workhorse wire; avoid over-shaping the tip.
rules.rationale: An aggressive tip angle causes the wire to preferentially follow the outer wall at the bend rather than the lumen.
rules.detail: A gentle curve navigates the angle more reliably than a sharply shaped tip.

rules.action: Soft-tipped workhorse wire for crossing; extra-support wire for device delivery after lesion preparation.
rules.rationale: Combined long-tortuous-severe calcification creates compound deliverability challenge. Stiff wire risks vessel trauma; soft wire may be insufficient for device delivery.
rules.detail: Consider GEC before escalating to stiffer wire. Exchange after successful lesion preparation rather than upfront.
rules.caution: Avoid aggressive wire manipulation in tortuous segments — perforation risk is elevated.
